notablePrerequisites: You have a red or green spell in hand that can be cast during an opponent's turn, along with the mana to cast it during that turn.
description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast a red or green spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
As the opponent, activate Tidal Control by paying 2 life, targeting the red or green spell.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 1 or less life remaining.
